default.notes: A consular visa is required, applied for through a Costa Rican consulate before travel. Costa Rica's nationality groupings change periodically — confirm with a consulate before booking.

groups.notes: Visa-free for tourism up to 180 days (first-group nationality). The border officer decides the days granted — check your entry stamp. Onward travel proof is strictly enforced by airlines at check-in.
Visa-free for a shorter stay (second-group nationality, typically up to 30 days on entry, extendable in-country). Groupings change periodically — confirm with a consulate before booking.
Restricted nationality — a consular visa with additional authorisation from Costa Rica's Immigration Directorate is required; allow extra processing time.

CR.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Costa Rican citizens.

RU.notes: Russian citizens can enter Costa Rica visa-free under the bilateral agreement, typically for up to 90 days. Confirm the current permitted stay with a consulate before booking, as Costa Rica's groupings change periodically.

VE.notes: Costa Rica reintroduced a consular visa requirement for Venezuelan citizens in 2022 — apply through a Costa Rican consulate before travel.
